command: set -euo pipefail; echo '===VOICE==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus -p Result -p NRestarts -p ExecStart -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo '===CLIENT==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID -p ExecMainStatus -p Result -p NRestarts -p ExecStart -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; VP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); CP=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); test "$VP" -gt 1; test "$CP" -gt 1; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$VP/cmdline; echo; tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$CP/cmdline; echo; /home/ai-core-node/.local/bin/omega selftest; echo OMEGA_POSTREADBACK_PASS
